nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: Cole! CODE RED. That's the serious one, right? Vane's pay train took the whole town's wages. Called it 'safekeeping'. Rolled it right onto the rails!

nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: EVERYONE'S. Mabel's, the farmers', even Sheriff Bly's — and he barely does anything!

nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: I AM breathing. This is my breathing-fast plan. It's a real plan.

nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: It's loading at the railhead east of town RIGHT NOW. Doc says: ride alongside, hop on, unhook the money cars, done. I'm to signal if there's trouble. Listen for my hawk.

nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: It's a HAWK, Cole. A complicated hawk.

nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: The wages. Only the wages. I know the Code, I helped paint it on the wall.
